title: Hourly Auto-Dig: Graphika headquarters evidence and current-news scan

data.research_question: Does current authoritative evidence explicitly establish which Graphika public office is headquarters, and is there material current Graphika news since the prior hourly pass?
data.method: Refreshed current main and operating contract through the GitHub connector. Reused the latest complete 54-topic pool, applied the previous-three successful-hourly dataset exclusions (fed, drunk-drivers, greater-israel), and first drew gop with seed 352679786028807130. Because open PR #1873 broadly edits the GOP research surface, gop was excluded for direct-conflict avoidance and the same deterministic RNG stream selected graphika. Within Graphika, selected the queued explicit-current-headquarters investigation target. Compared Graphika's first-party office page with current USAspending recipient data and a secondary federal-registration aggregator. Searched Graphika's current report surface and fresh web/news results after the prior 2026-08-18 Graphika pass; no material new event was found.
classification_rules: Dataset stage is approximately uniform across the complete 54-topic pool after diversity exclusions.
Previous three successful hourly datasets excluded: fed, drunk-drivers, greater-israel.
Previous-three dominant geographies avoided: Washington, D.C.; Utah; Israel.
GOP excluded after initial draw because open PR #1873 broadly overlaps the GOP research surface.
A federal award recipient address corroborates organizational location but is not by itself an explicit headquarters designation.
A secondary source calling New York headquarters is insufficient to override the stricter primary-source distinction when first-party and government records do not use headquarters language.
No filler news records are created when the post-cutoff search finds no material update.

findings.selection_algorithm: sorted full pool -> remove previous-three datasets -> random.Random(seed).choice; if selected dataset has broad direct active-PR overlap, remove it and repeat choice using the same seeded RNG sequence

findings.result: Connector search enumerated the normalized and packet investigation-target corpus, but the complete executable Free-Range actionable count could not be safely reproduced locally because direct GitHub DNS failed and the connector does not expose a repository archive endpoint. No count was fabricated.

USAspending currently lists Octant Data, LLC at 1230 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY 10020-1513, matching Graphika's published New York office. HigherGov labels New York as headquarters, but the reviewed primary sources do not explicitly do so; the headquarters target therefore remains unresolved.

findings.scope: Graphika first-party reports plus fresh web/news results after the prior 2026-08-18 Graphika hourly pass, with overlap back through 2026-07-30.
findings.result: No materially new post-prior-pass Graphika event or correction was found. The latest first-party research surface still tops out at the July 30, 2026 Spamouflage report, so no filler news record was ingested.

gaps: Primary-source explicit headquarters designation remains unresolved.
Exact whole-corpus actionable Free-Range target count could not be reproduced in the connector-only runtime.
